shortBio.zh: 基于 Mihomo (Clash Meta) 内核的新一代跨平台客户端，支持规则分流、TUN 虚拟网卡与现代化极简 UI。
shortBio.en: Next-generation cross-platform proxy client powered by Mihomo kernel, featuring smart rules, TUN mode, and modern UI.

biography.zh:
Clash Verge Rev 是 2026 年桌面端（Windows、macOS、Linux）事实上的第一主力代理客户端。随着旧版 Clash for Windows 停止维护，基于 Tauri + Rust 与全新 Mihomo (Clash.Meta) 内核构建的 Clash Verge Rev 迅速完成了对全平台的代际更替。

该软件完全开源、轻量纯净，闲置时内存占用仅 30MB–60MB。它原生支持 VLESS、XTLS-Reality、Trojan、Shadowsocks 2022、Hysteria 2、TUIC v5 等全套现代抗探测协议，杜绝了老旧协议被防火墙指纹识别的风险。

其内置的 TUN 模式能够直接创建系统级虚拟网卡适配器，实现对终端命令行（PowerShell / Bash）、Git 版本控制、Steam 与游戏客户端的全流量智能分流。配合 Nameserver-Policy 与 Fake-IP 高阶防污染配置，可彻底解决 ChatGPT 403 阻断及 DNS 泄漏问题。建议搭配光速云 2.5Gbps IEPL 专线使用。
biography.en:
Clash Verge Rev has become the definitive desktop proxy client for Windows, macOS, and Linux in 2026. Built on Tauri, Rust, and the actively maintained Mihomo (Clash.Meta) kernel, it replaces deprecated legacy implementations with unmatched speed and security.

Completely open source with a lightweight 40MB idle footprint, it natively supports VLESS, XTLS-Reality, Trojan, Shadowsocks 2022, Hysteria 2, and TUIC v5. Its built-in TUN virtual interface mode routes all system traffic including terminal commands, Git syncs, and game engines seamlessly.

When paired with modern DNS-over-HTTPS (DoH) and Fake-IP routing, Clash Verge Rev completely mitigates DNS leaks and Cloudflare 403 challenges on AI platforms like ChatGPT and Claude. Highly recommended alongside Guangsu Cloud 2.5Gbps IEPL dedicated lines.

quote.zh: 现代桌面端最优雅、强大的跨平台代理分流工具。
quote.en: The most capable, lightweight, and elegant desktop proxy client for modern protocols.
